description: This file defines the Imap2Handler class, a wrapper for interactions with the imap2 library, including methods for mailbox management, message retrieval, and flags handling for an email IMAP client within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: Imap2Handler
classes.description: A wrapper class for the imap2 library facilitating email mailbox and message operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing logging options, logger instance, and character set.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current IMAP stream/connection resource.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last IMAP error message.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the imap2 functions are available.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings the IMAP connection to keep it alive.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for IMAP functions.

methods.name: executeImapCmd
methods.description: Executes a callback with IMAP error handling, especially for charset issues.

methods.name: getHeaderInfo
methods.description: Retrieves header info for a message.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a message to a mailbox.

methods.name: fetchBody
methods.description: Fetches the body part of a message.

methods.name: internalFetchBody
methods.description: Internal method for fetching message body parts.

methods.name: getNumberOfMessages
methods.description: Gets total number of messages in current mailbox.
